product_one_liner.value: Marquee combines club knowledge and football data with AI to give professional football clubs decision-ready recruitment, squad-planning and match-analysis insights.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public plans were found; the site directs prospects to early access or a demo, and the pricing path returned no page.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical build posts: CTO Jonathan Hazut on the production AI/ML pipeline and infrastructure (2026-10-21), and Chief Data Scientist Tal Darchi on the Squad Fit model (2026-09-25).

public_docs.notes: The public help material found is a single FAQ page; no multi-article documentation or developer portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior AI Scientist; recruiting post dated 2026-11-03 and a readable live job listing.

model_provider.value: Marquee’s own proprietary AI/ML models, including transformers and graph neural networks.
model_provider.notes: No external model vendor or specific third-party foundation model was identified in the public product, FAQ, technical or security material inspected; no public subprocessor list was found.

last_funding.notes: The July 30 report identifies a $4 million seed round; the company announcement’s $6.5 million is cumulative funding, not the individual round amount.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive posting was found. The readable company page did not provide a complete current vacancies list, so absence cannot be established; the commercial opening found was Head of Business Development, which does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-07-14 Marquee announced that SkillCorner Physical and Game Intelligence data could now be used through its platform, a new data integration within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Gad Sharon’s profile dates his start as VP R&D to July 2026, within the requested window; the company team page confirms the title.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Readable technical and commercial job descriptions name no CRM or sales/marketing platform. Football-data vendors are not counted as CRM systems.
